newsitem.title: UK: Harvey Nash Group Plc plans April flotation.
newsitem.headline: Harvey Nash Group Plc plans April flotation.

text.p: UK recruitment services group Harvey Nash said on Tuesday it plans to float on the London Stock Exchange via a placing.

The placing will raise 15 million stg, valuing the group at 45.0 million stg, a spokesman for the company said. The issue will be priced at the end of March, with first dealings in the shares in April.

Harvey Nash, which provides information technology professionals for permanent and temporary positions in Europe, said it was one of the leading players in its sector, with a broad client base across a wide range of industries.
The group will use the proceeds from the issue to fund the float and increase working capital, the spokesman said.
The broker to the float is NatWest Markets Corporate Finance Limited.
